انضربن (form VII)
# اِنْضَرَبْنَ (inḍarabna) /in.dˤa.rab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# اِنْضَرِبْنَ (inḍaribna) /in.dˤa.rib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
